email.body:
Dear {{ contact.first_name }},

Congratulations. Your book is delivered, and you are a published author. From your first chapter to this finished manuscript, our editors have worked alongside you at every step.

View your book PDF here:
{{ contact.anthology_manuscript_pdf_url }}

Edit your manuscript in the Google Doc here:
{{ contact.anthology_manuscript_doc_url }}

The PDF is yours to view. The Google Doc is the one you edit, and it is the version we use.

If you have any final requests, open the delivery form here:
https://link.msgsndr.com/widget/form/<form_id>?anthology_id={{ contact.anthology_active_id }}&stage=delivered

Warm regards,
The Editors
